blocks.arabic_text: إِلي فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغي ۞ فَقُولَا لَهُ قَولاً لَّيِّناً لَّعَلَّهُ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَي ۞ قَالَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَا أَوْ أَنْ يَطْغَي ۞ قَالَ لَا تَخَافَا إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَا أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَي۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Go, you and your brother, with My signs (to the people); and do not both grow weak in remembering Me. Go, both of you, to Fir'awn; indeed he has transgressed. “Speak to him, both of you, a gentle (soft) word; (by it) perhaps he may take heed or feel fear (of Me)” (Allah said). “Our Lord, we truly fear that he will act hastily against us (in punishment), or that he will transgress,” both of them said. “Do not fear, both of you; indeed I am with you both, hearing and seeing (everything),” He said.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِّنَ اللهِ لِنْتَ لَهُمْ ۚ وَلَوْ كُنْتَ فَظًَّا غَلِيظَ الْقَلْبِ لَانْفَضُّوا مِنْ حَوْلِكَ ص فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِي اْلاَمْرِ ۚ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَي اللهِ ؕ إِنَ اللهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: It is only because of the mercy from Allah that you (O Messenger) dealt gently (and compassionately) with them; had you been harsh and hard-hearted, they would have scattered away from you. So pardon them! And seek forgiveness (from Allah) for them! And consult them in the matter! When you have resolved (to do it),
